text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Oka Sho. Upon arriving 
at our hotel—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah! —Craft, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Heart-san! We're in the same hotel!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —...My. Are all of you here as well?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little surprised...! Even though 
there are so many hotels around here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Everyone gathered around before the 
race."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Anyway... None of you have had 
dinner yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, why don't we hit the 
buffet together? I hear everything here is 
exquisite!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd love to go, more than anything. 
But... tomorrow, we—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Rivals fighting for a single Tiara. Yet... 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course I won't force you! But 
tomorrow's match is just so important, 
that's why—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I want to savor it. Even this time, 
before the outcome is decided."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I drop my bags in my room and catch my 
breath. I plan to reorganize the materials 
before dinner. As for Daring Heart—
choice_data_list:
—I wonder if they're having fun right 
about now?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Mmh~, so good!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario! You should totally go grab 10 
more slices of roast beef! With lots of 
gravy, too♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you just want to eat some craft 
cheese, don't you? I'll bring you some 
later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, I'll go! I just thought 
of a wonderful arrangement!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san... that's safe to drink, right? 
I haven't forgotten that crazy concoction 
you made at the family restaurant, you 
know...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, really! This is just one of 
those... weird synergy things!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Because she was just... so completely 
normal."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Why are we—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
With a rival you study thoroughly and 
yearn to defeat. With a rival whose face 
you can't even look at right after losing 
because of the sheer frustration—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: How can we laugh together like this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that precisely why?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"We are communicating through our races— 
clashing our true feelings against one 
another directly from the heart."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Admiration, hatred, joy, regret... We can 
truly understand each other's raw, naked 
feelings—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because we win and lose 
together time and time again... that our 
bond runs so much deeper.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ......Yes. That may, indeed, be true.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Not "maybe"... I know it is for sure! 
Because—I love everyone so much!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so, so happy that I get to aim for 
the Triple Tiara together with everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Me too... I'm so—so excited for 
tomorrow, when we can all finally compete 
together.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Tsk, tsk, tsk! You guys are far too soft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's looking forward to this 
—more than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Oka Sho had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
My top pick is Cesario! I mean, once you 
see that finishing stretch of hers! ♡ She 
totally feels like the last true 
superstar!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely betting on Rhein Kraft. 
That speed of hers will shine in the mile 
Oka Sho! The first crown is as good as 
hers!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"...I guess I'm rooting for Messiah-san. I 
used to cheer for her mother too... I'd 
really love to see her win."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess it comes down to these three, 
huh? The ones likely to take center stage 
for this year's Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text: ...W-Wait!! I'm—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text: I think Daring Heart-chan is gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Heart-san! I came to cheer for you 
today! Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Keep cheering me on until the 
very end, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder how many that makes now? 
Fufu, it seems my fans have really grown 
in number♪"
choice_data_list:
Because you've been steadily delivering 
results

Because you've been steadily delivering 
results, you know

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A "look at me" face? Hehe, you're so 
honest and cute!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All right, then! Let's do a quick strategy 
meeting! Let's go♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, okay. Understood. I'll keep an eye 
on her movements.
choice_data_list: Yeah, looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, Daring Heart is 
calm. I thought she might be worked up 
with the long-awaited Oka Sho just ahead, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if that worked out. All right, 
let's move on to stretching.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, is it kind of hot today, or is it 
just me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A Classic race feels totally different—I 
felt super dizzy the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: Hey, aren't you getting really worked up?

Aren't you feeling super pumped up right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no, this is bad! I can't run 
calmly like this... Calm down, Heart...
choice_data_list:
...No, there's no need to be too 
level-headed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list:
Your fiery fighting spirit is one of your 
strengths.

That fiery fighting spirit is one of your 
best qualities.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer...
choice_data_list: Be brave, Heart. You are the queen.
Be brave, Heart. You are the queen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...You've truly grown so much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Of course I'm the queen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you polish up my throne real 
nice, okay?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Uooooh...!" "Craft—!!" "Go, Cesario!" 
"Messiah...!" "Heart, do your best~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You've finally reached this point, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To the stage of our dreams. âRight, 
Craft, Cesario, Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! This is... the Triple 
Tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...A race where we clash fiercely. Staking 
everything on our own convictions—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Who will claim the first tiara...? We'll 
find out very soon."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...If I don't achieve it—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Messiah! I love your strong determination 
and devotion to your mother!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You may say you're plain, but that 
steadfastness is a virtue. —Let's see how 
it fares against my pride!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Likewise. I shall see these feelings 
through to the end."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Cesario! I've been waiting for you! You'll 
show me what you've got to make up for it, 
won't you? —That explosive power of yours!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The sheer strength of your will to reach 
the top... It's practically burned into 
your back. Still—don't go underestimating 
my fire, either!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Then—before you burn yourself to ashes, I 
shall outrun you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And... Craft. ...You and I are a little 
alike.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how fast you are... I will not 
break! Right before your very eyes— I will 
shine brightest of all!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
......! No, I'm going to cross that finish 
line first!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Tiara... will be mine!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's my line! ――I will make it shine 
above my own head!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Let us give it our best—and clash our 
'hearts' against one another!"
